blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. on Tuesday rejected China’s accusation that he had sabotaged joint oil and gas exploration talks with Beijing, saying former President Rodrigo Duterte had already terminated the negotiations in 2022. Teodoro said the decision to end the talks under a 2018 framework between Manila and Beijing was made over constitutional concerns upon the advice of then-Foreign Affairs Secretary Teodoro Locsin Jr. “The 2018 framework was canceled by no less than former President Duterte in 2022 for being potentially constitutionally problematic upon the advice of then-secretary Teodoro Locsin, not me,” he said in an interview […]...
